title: एनपीएलमा फ्लप भए यी ५ घरेलु ब्याट्सम्यान, कसको प्रदर्शन कस्तो ?
content:
No ads found for this position काठमाडौं । तेस्रो संस्करणको नेपाल प्रिमियर लिग (एनपीएल) सम्पन्न भएको छ । शनिबार भएको फाइनल खेलमा सुदूरपश्चिम रोयल्सले लुम्बिनी लायन्सलाई सहजै हराउँदै आफ्नो पहिलो उपाधि हात पार्‍यो । झण्डै एक महिना चलेको प्रतियोगितामा केही खेलाडीले उत्कृष्ट प्रदर्शन गर्दा राष्ट्रिय टोलीका अनुभवी तथा चर्चित खेलाडी भने अपेक्षाअनुसार चल्न सकेनन् । लुम्बिनी लायन्सका आसिफ शेख, सुदूरपश्चिम रोयल्सका आरिफ शेख, चितवन राइनोजका कुशल मल्ल, जनकपुर बोल्ट्सका अनिल शाह र काठमान्डु गोर्खाजका आदिल आलम यस संस्करणमा प्रभाव जमाउन नसकेका पाँच खेलाडी हुन् । यी पाँचै खेलाडीले प्रतियोगिताका क्रममा ब्याटिङमा संघर्ष गरे । पाँच खेलाडीको प्रदर्शन १. आसिफ शेख (लुम्बिनी लायन्स) लुम्बिनीका ओपनर आसिफ शेखले आठ खेलमा ब्याटिङ गर्दै जम्मा ११२ रन बनाए । उनले पहिलो खेलमा सुदूरपश्चिमविरुद्ध ३२ रन बनाएका थिए । दोस्रो खेलमा पोखराविरुद्ध ७ र तेस्रो खेलमा जनकपुरविरुद्ध २१ रन जोडे । त्यसपछि उनको प्रदर्शन झन् कमजोर बन्यो । काठमान्डु र कर्णालीविरुद्ध समान १ रन बनाएका आसिफले विराटनगरविरुद्ध ४५ रन बनाए । तर त्यसपछिका दुई खेलमा सुदूरपश्चिमविरुद्ध क्रमशः ४ र १ रनमै आउट भए । २. आरिफ शेख (सुदूरपश्चिम रोयल्स) सुदूरपश्चिमले उपाधि जितेपनि मध्यक्रमका ब्याट्सम्यान आरिफ शेखले भने ब्याटिङमा अपेक्षाअनुसार प्रदर्शन गर्न सकेनन् । उनले आठ इनिङ्समा ८९ रन बनाए । पहिलो खेलमा लुम्बिनीविरुद्ध शून्य रनमा आउट भएका आरिफले विराटनगरविरुद्ध १७ र चितवनविरुद्ध अविजित २० रन बनाएका थिए । त्यसपछि लगातार चार खेलमा ११, ११, १६ र ४ रन बनाए । एलिमिनेटरमा चितवनविरुद्ध १० रन जोडेका उनले फाइनलमा ब्याटिङ गर्ने अवसर पाएनन् । ३. कुशल मल्ल (चितवन राइनोज) चितवनका मार्की खेलाडीसमेत रहेका कुशल मल्लको ब्याटिङ पनि प्रभावकारी हुन सकेन । उनले ६ इनिङ्समा जम्मा ५८ रन बनाए । पोखराविरुद्ध ११, काठमान्डुविरुद्ध १३, जनकपुरविरुद्ध १५ र कर्णालीविरुद्ध १८ रन बनाएका कुशल त्यसपछिका दुई खेलमा भने चल्न सकेनन् । काठमान्डुविरुद्ध शून्य र एलिमिनेटरमा सुदूरपश्चिमविरुद्ध १ रनमा आउट भए । बलिङमा पनि उनले पाँच इनिङ्समा जम्मा दुई विकेट मात्रै लिन सके । ४. अनिल शाह (जनकपुर बोल्ट्स) जनकपुरका अनिल शाहका लागि पनि यो संस्करण बिर्सनलायक रह्यो । उनले पाँच खेलमा जम्मा २३ रन मात्रै बनाउन सके । कर्णालीविरुद्ध ११ र पोखराविरुद्ध ९ रन बनाएका अनिल विराटनगरविरुद्ध शून्य, लुम्बिनीविरुद्ध १ र सुदूरपश्चिमविरुद्ध २ रनमा आउट भए । ५. आदिल आलम (काठमान्डु गोर्खाज) काठमान्डुका आदिल आलमले पाँच खेलमा ३८ रन मात्रै बनाए । उनले जनकपुरविरुद्ध खाता खोल्न सकेनन् । कर्णालीविरुद्ध २० रन बनाए पनि त्यसपछिका खेलमा उनको प्रदर्शन कमजोर रह्यो । लुम्बिनीविरुद्ध १, चितवनविरुद्ध ९ र सुदूरपश्चिमविरुद्ध ८ रन बनाउँदै उनी पभेलियन फर्किए । Kathmandu. The third edition of the Nepal Premier League (NPL) has concluded. In the final match on Saturday, Sudurpaschim Royals easily defeated Lumbini Lions to win their first title. While some players performed excellently in the competition that lasted for almost a month, the experienced and famous players of the national team did not perform as expected. Asif Sheikh of Lumbini Lions, Arif Sheikh of Sudurpaschim Royals, Kushal Malla of Chitwan Rhinos, Anil Shah of Janakpur Bolts, and Adil Alam of Kathmandu Gorkhas are the five players who failed to make an impact in this edition. All five of these players struggled with their batting during the tournament. Performance of five players 1. Asif Sheikh (Lumbini Lions) Lumbini opener Asif Sheikh batted in eight matches and scored a total of 112 runs. He scored 32 runs against Sudurpaschim in the first match, 7 runs against Pokhara in the second match, and 21 runs against Janakpur in the third match. After that, his performance deteriorated further. Asif, who scored 1 run each against Kathmandu and Karnali, scored 45 runs against Biratnagar. But in the next two matches, he was dismissed for 4 and 1 run respectively against Sudurpaschim. 2. Arif Sheikh (Fur West Royals) Although Sudurpaschim won the title, middle-order batsman Arif Sheikh failed to perform as expected with the bat. He scored 89 runs in eight innings. Arif, who was dismissed for zero runs against Lumbini in the first match, scored 17 runs against Biratnagar and an unbeaten 20 runs against Chitwan. After that, he scored 11, 11, 16 and 4 runs in four consecutive matches. He scored 10 runs against Chitwan in the eliminator but did not get a chance to bat in the final. 3. Kushal Malla (Chitwan Rhinos) Kushal Malla, who is also Chitwan's marquee player, also failed to bat effectively. He scored a total of 58 runs in 6 innings. Kushal, who scored 11 runs against Pokhara, 13 against Kathmandu, 15 against Janakpur and 18 against Karnali, failed to perform in the next two matches. They were dismissed for zero against Kathmandu and 1 run against Sudurpaschim in the Eliminator. In bowling too, he could only take two wickets in five innings. 4. Anil Shah (Janakpur Bolts) This edition was also a forgettable one for Anil Shah of Janakpur. He could only score 23 runs in five matches. Anil, who scored 11 runs against Karnali and 9 runs against Pokhara, was dismissed for zero runs against Biratnagar, 1 against Lumbini, and 2 runs against Sudurpaschim. 5. Adil Alam (Kathmandu Gorkhas) Kathmandu's Adil Alam scored only 38 runs in five matches. He could not open his account against Janakpur. Despite scoring 20 runs against Karnali, his performance in the following matches was poor. He returned to the pavilion after scoring 1 against Lumbini, 9 against Chitwan, and 8 against Sudurpaschim.

त्यसपछिका दुई खेलमा सुदूरपश्चिमविरुद्ध क्रमशः ४ र १ रनमै आउट भए । २. आरिफ शेख (सुदूरपश्चिम रोयल्स) सुदूरपश्चिमले उपाधि जितेपनि मध्यक्रमका ब्याट्सम्यान आरिफ शेखले भने ब्याटिङमा अपेक्षाअनुसार प्रदर्शन गर्न सकेनन् । उनले आठ इनिङ्समा ८९ रन बनाए । पहिलो खेलमा लुम्बिनीविरुद्ध शून्य रनमा आउट भएका आरिफले विराटनगरविरुद्ध १७ र चितवनविरुद्ध अविजित २० रन बनाएका थिए । त्यसपछि लगातार चार खेलमा ११, ११, १६ र ४ रन बनाए । एलिमिनेटरमा चितवनविरुद्ध १० रन जोडेका उनले फाइनलमा ब्याटिङ गर्ने अवसर पाएनन् । ३. कुशल मल्ल (चितवन राइनोज) चितवनका मार्की खेलाडीसमेत रहेका कुशल मल्लको ब्याटिङ पनि प्रभावकारी हुन सकेन । उनले ६ इनिङ्समा जम्मा ५८ रन बनाए । पोखराविरुद्ध ११, काठमान्डुविरुद्ध १३, जनकपुरविरुद्ध १५ र कर्णालीविरुद्ध १८ रन बनाएका कुशल त्यसपछिका दुई खेलमा भने चल्न सकेनन् । काठमान्डुविरुद्ध शून्य र एलिमिनेटरमा सुदूरपश्चिमविरुद्ध १ रनमा आउट भए । बलिङमा पनि उनले पाँच इनिङ्समा जम्मा दुई विकेट मात्रै लिन सके । ४. अनिल शाह (जनकपुर बोल्ट्स) जनकपुरका अनिल शाहका लागि पनि यो संस्करण बिर्सनलायक रह्यो । उनले पाँच खेलमा जम्मा २३ रन मात्रै बनाउन सके । कर्णालीविरुद्ध ११ र पोखराविरुद्ध ९ रन बनाएका अनिल विराटनगरविरुद्ध शून्य, लुम्बिनीविरुद्ध १ र सुदूरपश्चिमविरुद्ध २ रनमा आउट भए । ५. आदिल आलम (काठमान्डु गोर्खाज) काठमान्डुका आदिल आलमले पाँच खेलमा ३८ रन मात्रै बनाए । उनले जनकपुरविरुद्ध खाता खोल्न सकेनन् । कर्णालीविरुद्ध २० रन बनाए पनि त्यसपछिका खेलमा उनको प्रदर्शन कमजोर रह्यो । लुम्बिनीविरुद्ध १, चितवनविरुद्ध ९ र सुदूरपश्चिमविरुद्ध ८ रन बनाउँदै उनी पभेलियन फर्किए । Kathmandu. The third edition of the Nepal Premier League (NPL) has concluded. In the final match on Saturday, Sudurpaschim Royals easily defeated Lumbini Lions to win their first title. While some players performed excellently in the competition that lasted for almost a month, the experienced and famous players of the national team did not perform as expected. Asif Sheikh of Lumbini Lions, Arif Sheikh of Sudurpaschim Royals, Kushal Malla of Chitwan Rhinos, Anil Shah of Janakpur Bolts, and Adil Alam of Kathmandu Gorkhas are the five players who failed to make an impact in this edition. All five of these players struggled with their batting during the tournament. Performance of five players 1. Asif Sheikh (Lumbini Lions) Lumbini opener Asif Sheikh batted in eight matches and scored a total of 112 runs. He scored 32 runs against Sudurpaschim in the first match, 7 runs against Pokhara in the second match, and 21 runs against Janakpur in the third match. After that, his performance deteriorated further. Asif, who scored 1 run each against Kathmandu and Karnali, scored 45 runs against Biratnagar. But in the next two matches, he was dismissed for 4 and 1 run respectively against Sudurpaschim. 2. Arif Sheikh (Fur West Royals) Although Sudurpaschim won the title, middle-order batsman Arif Sheikh failed to perform as expected with the bat. He scored 89 runs in eight innings. Arif, who was dismissed for zero runs against Lumbini in the first match, scored 17 runs against Biratnagar and an unbeaten 20 runs against Chitwan. After that, he scored 11, 11, 16 and 4 runs in four consecutive matches. He scored 10 runs against Chitwan in the eliminator but did not get a chance to bat in the final. 3. Kushal Malla (Chitwan Rhinos) Kushal Malla, who is also Chitwan's marquee player, also failed to bat effectively. He scored a total of 58 runs in 6 innings. Kushal, who scored 11 runs against Pokhara, 13 against Kathmandu, 15 against Janakpur and 18 against Karnali, failed to perform in the next two matches. They were dismissed for zero against Kathmandu and 1 run against Sudurpaschim in the Eliminator. In bowling too, he could only take two wickets in five innings. 4. Anil Shah (Janakpur Bolts) This edition was also a forgettable one for Anil Shah of Janakpur. He could only score 23 runs in five matches. Anil, who scored 11 runs against Karnali and 9 runs against Pokhara, was dismissed for zero runs against Biratnagar, 1 against Lumbini, and 2 runs against Sudurpaschim. 5. Adil Alam (Kathmandu Gorkhas) Kathmandu's Adil Alam scored only 38 runs in five matches. He could not open his account against Janakpur. Despite scoring 20 runs against Karnali, his performance in the following matches was poor. He returned to the pavilion after scoring 1 against Lumbini, 9 against Chitwan, and 8 against Sudurpaschim.

Performance of five players

1. Asif Sheikh (Lumbini Lions)

Lumbini opener Asif Sheikh batted in eight matches and scored a total of 112 runs. He scored 32 runs against Sudurpaschim in the first match, 7 runs against Pokhara in the second match, and 21 runs against Janakpur in the third match.

After that, his performance deteriorated further. Asif, who scored 1 run each against Kathmandu and Karnali, scored 45 runs against Biratnagar. But in the next two matches, he was dismissed for 4 and 1 run respectively against Sudurpaschim.

2. Arif Sheikh (Fur West Royals)

Although Sudurpaschim won the title, middle-order batsman Arif Sheikh failed to perform as expected with the bat. He scored 89 runs in eight innings.

Arif, who was dismissed for zero runs against Lumbini in the first match, scored 17 runs against Biratnagar and an unbeaten 20 runs against Chitwan.

After that, he scored 11, 11, 16 and 4 runs in four consecutive matches. He scored 10 runs against Chitwan in the eliminator but did not get a chance to bat in the final.

3. Kushal Malla (Chitwan Rhinos)

Kushal Malla, who is also Chitwan's marquee player, also failed to bat effectively. He scored a total of 58 runs in 6 innings.

Kushal, who scored 11 runs against Pokhara, 13 against Kathmandu, 15 against Janakpur and 18 against Karnali, failed to perform in the next two matches.

They were dismissed for zero against Kathmandu and 1 run against Sudurpaschim in the Eliminator.

In bowling too, he could only take two wickets in five innings.

4. Anil Shah (Janakpur Bolts)

This edition was also a forgettable one for Anil Shah of Janakpur. He could only score 23 runs in five matches.

Anil, who scored 11 runs against Karnali and 9 runs against Pokhara, was dismissed for zero runs against Biratnagar, 1 against Lumbini, and 2 runs against Sudurpaschim.

5. Adil Alam (Kathmandu Gorkhas)

Kathmandu's Adil Alam scored only 38 runs in five matches. He could not open his account against Janakpur. Despite scoring 20 runs against Karnali, his performance in the following matches was poor.

He returned to the pavilion after scoring 1 against Lumbini, 9 against Chitwan, and 8 against Sudurpaschim.
